components.name: Outline Button
components.description: The neutral shadcn action: hairline border, page ground with a 30% border-tint fill, hover to raised graphite; lime border + 3px half-alpha lime ring on focus.
components.css: .ds-btn { font: 500 14px -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; height: 32px; padding: 0 10px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 6px; border: 1px solid var(--border, #26292e); border-radius: 12px; background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--border, #26292e) 30%, var(--bg, #0b0d10)); color: var(--fg, #f2f3f5); cursor: pointer; white-space: nowrap; outline: none; transition: background-color 80ms ease-out, color 80ms ease-out, border-color 80ms ease-out, box-shadow 80ms ease-out; } .ds-btn:hover:not(:disabled) { background: var(--bg-alt, #121417); } .ds-btn:active:not(:disabled) { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { border-color: var(--accent, #E5FF44); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(var(--accent-rgb, 229, 255, 68), 0.5); } .ds-btn:disabled { opacity: 0.5; pointer-events: none; }

components.css: .ds-btn-primary { font: 500 14px -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; height: 32px; padding: 0 10px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 6px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 12px; background: var(--accent, #E5FF44); color: var(--on-accent, #10131a); cursor: pointer; white-space: nowrap; outline: none; transition: background-color 80ms ease-out, box-shadow 80ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-primary:hover:not(:disabled) { background: rgba(var(--accent-rgb, 229, 255, 68), 0.8); } .ds-btn-primary:active:not(:disabled) { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { border-color: var(--accent, #E5FF44); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(var(--accent-rgb, 229, 255, 68), 0.5); } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.5; pointer-events: none; }

components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; width: 260px; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; } .ds-field-label { font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.375; color: var(--fg, #f2f3f5); } .ds-input { font: 400 14px -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; height: 32px; width: 100%; color: var(--fg, #f2f3f5); background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--border, #26292e) 30%, transparent); border: 1px solid var(--border, #26292e); border-radius: 12px; padding: 4px 10px; outline: none; transition: border-color 80ms ease-out, box-shadow 80ms ease-out; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--fg-muted, #8b9096); } .ds-input:focus-visible { border-color: var(--accent, #E5FF44); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(var(--accent-rgb, 229, 255, 68), 0.5); } .ds-input[aria-invalid=true] { border-color: var(--error, #ff6b6b); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(var(--error-rgb, 255, 107, 107), 0.2); } .ds-field-desc { margin: 0; font-size: 14px; color: var(--fg-muted, #8b9096); }

components.css: .ds-sidebar { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px; padding: 8px; width: 200px; background: var(--bg-rail, #08090b); font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; } .ds-sidebar-item { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; padding: 7px 10px; border-radius: 8px; font-size: 13.5px; white-space: nowrap; color: var(--fg, #f2f3f5); text-decoration: none; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 80ms ease-out, color 80ms ease-out; } .ds-sidebar-item:hover { background: rgba(var(--tint, 255, 255, 255), 0.06); } .ds-sidebar-item.ds-active { background: rgba(var(--tint, 255, 255, 255), 0.06); box-shadow: inset 2px 0 0 var(--accent, #E5FF44); } .ds-sidebar-item:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: inset 2px 0 0 var(--accent, #E5FF44), 0 0 0 3px rgba(var(--accent-rgb, 229, 255, 68), 0.5); }

components.css: .ds-listing { border-collapse: collapse; width: 100%; background: var(--bg, #0b0d10); font: 400 14px -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; color: var(--fg, #f2f3f5); } .ds-listing td { padding: 9px 16px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border, #26292e); white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; } .ds-row { cursor: pointer; user-select: none; outline: none; transition: background-color 80ms ease-out; } .ds-row:hover { background: var(--bg-alt, #121417); } .ds-row.ds-selected { background: var(--row-bg-active, #262a15); } .ds-row.ds-selected > td:first-child, .ds-row:focus-visible > td:first-child { box-shadow: inset 2px 0 0 var(--accent, #E5FF44); } .ds-size { text-align: right; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-size, .ds-mtime { font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, monospace; font-size: 12px; color: var(--fg-muted, #8b9096); }

components.name: Badge

components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 4px; height: 20px; padding: 2px 8px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 999px; font: 500 12px -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; white-space: nowrap; background: var(--bg-alt, #121417); color: var(--fg, #f2f3f5); transition: background-color 80ms ease-out, box-shadow 80ms ease-out; } .ds-badge-outline { background: transparent; border-color: var(--border, #26292e); } .ds-badge-destructive { background: rgba(var(--error-rgb, 255, 107, 107), 0.2); color: var(--error, #ff6b6b); } .ds-badge:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: var(--accent, #E5FF44); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(var(--accent-rgb, 229, 255, 68), 0.5); }

components.css: .ds-menu { display: inline-flex; flex-direction: column; min-width: 160px; padding: 4px; border-radius: 12px; background: var(--bg-popover, #14161a); color: var(--fg, #f2f3f5); font: 400 14px -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px color-mix(in srgb, var(--fg, #f2f3f5) 10%, transparent), 0 4px 6px -1px var(--shadow-ink, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.45)), 0 2px 4px -2px var(--shadow-ink, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.45)); } .ds-menu-item { position: relative; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 4px 6px; border-radius: 8px; cursor: default; user-select: none; outline: none; transition: background-color 80ms ease-out; } .ds-menu-item:hover, .ds-menu-item:focus-visible, .ds-menu-item.ds-highlighted { background: var(--row-bg-hover, #1a1d22); color: var(--fg, #f2f3f5); } .ds-menu-destructive { color: var(--error, #ff6b6b); } .ds-menu-destructive:hover, .ds-menu-destructive:focus-visible { background: rgba(var(--error-rgb, 255, 107, 107), 0.2); color: var(--error, #ff6b6b); } .ds-menu-sep { height: 1px; margin: 4px -4px; background: var(--border, #26292e); } .ds-menu-kbd { margin-left: auto; font-size: 12px; color: var(--fg-muted, #8b9096); }

narrative.overview: fused-render dresses the whole machine as a first-class developer product: the modern dev-tool canon (benchmarked against Linear, Vercel dashboard, Raycast — user-chosen) executed at full craft, with no irony and no smuggled quirk. The world is a deep near-black ground with a sidebar rail that recedes darker than the pane it borders, off-white ink, hairline borders, and exactly one loud voice: Fused Lime (#E5FF44), reserved for "you are here" and "do this". Density is high and calm — dense tables, quiet chrome, translucent tint-washes instead of new grays. Every color on every surface is a CSS custom property defined in frontend/src/styles/tokens.css, dark-first with a full light counterpart; tests/test_theme.py enforces both halves of that contract. Since the shadcn migration the component vocabulary is shadcn (base-nova style on base-ui primitives, frontend/src/platform/shadcn/ui/*), and it reaches those tokens through one bridge file: every shadcn semantic variable in frontend/src/styles/tailwind.css is an alias onto a canon token, so the shadcn layer has no palette of its own.
keyCharacteristics: One lime signal per grammar: active nav marker, selection edge, focus ring, primary fill, checked state — nothing else.
Rail (#08090b) darker than page (#0b0d10) darker-side of raised (#121417): the pane is the lit surface.
Hairline #26292e borders carry structure on bespoke surfaces; shadcn floating surfaces wear a faint ink ring plus a tokenized shadow.
Three motion durations (80/150/200ms), one ease-out, shell-wide; shadcn overlays add a 100ms fade/zoom entry.

rules.name: The One-Lime-Signal Rule
rules.body: Fused Lime appears only as: the 2px active-nav inset marker, the selected-row wash + 2px first-cell inset, the focus treatment (lime border plus a 3px half-alpha lime ring), the checked/on fill of Checkbox, Radio and Switch, and the single primary-button fill. It never decorates, never fills large areas, never colors prose.

rules.name: The Token Rule
rules.body: No color literal exists outside the two palette blocks in tokens.css. Every rule paints with var(--token); every dark token has a light counterpart (tests/test_theme.py enforces both).

rules.name: The Rail-Recedes Rule
rules.body: The sidebar rail is always a step darker than the pane it borders (--bg-rail < --bg < --bg-alt), in both themes — the pane is the lit surface; later tuning must not invert the ordering.

rules.name: The Mono-for-Measurement Rule
rules.body: Anything measured — bytes, timestamps — renders in ui-monospace, one size down (12px), muted, with tabular numerals. Prose and names never take mono; measurements never take the sans voice.

rules.name: The Tonal-First Rule
rules.body: Resting surfaces separate by ground step and hairline, never by shadow; a shadow means the surface floats above the page.

rules.name: The Bridge Rule
rules.body: A shadcn semantic variable is only ever an alias onto a canon token, never a literal: --primary, --ring, --sidebar-primary = --accent; --primary-foreground = --on-accent; --sh-accent, --sidebar-accent = --row-bg-hover; --muted, --secondary, --card = --bg-alt; --popover = --bg-popover; --sh-border, --input = --border; --destructive = --error; --chart-n = --series-n. The bridge has no theme branches — canon tokens already flip with data-theme, and a second light block would drift. Mapping is by role, not by name: shadcn's "accent" is the hover wash, not the brand lime; the brand lime is "primary" and "ring". The same principle governs the four names both vocabularies claim (--shadow-sm/md/lg, --ease-out): re-declared on [data-slot] with Tailwind's geometry and the app's --shadow-ink*, so shadcn keeps its shapes and the palette keeps its colors.

dos: Do paint every color with a var(--token) from tokens.css and give any new dark token a light counterpart.

Do reach for the shadcn component first (@platform/shadcn/ui/*) and style it with semantic classes (bg-primary, border-input, text-muted-foreground) — never with a canon token name or a literal in className.
Do draw selection/active edges as 2px inset box-shadows in Fused Lime, never as borders that shift text.
Do keep the rail darker than the pane in any new surface ordering (--bg-rail < --bg < --bg-alt).
Do set measurements (sizes, timestamps, counts) in ui-monospace 12px muted with tabular-nums.
Do pick transitions from the three tokens (80/150/200ms, ease-out); one primary lime fill per screen.
Do open every dialog through Modal so the busy gate and dirty guard travel with it.
donts: Don't hardcode a color literal outside the two palette blocks in tokens.css (test-enforced) — and never set a shadcn variable in tailwind.css to anything but a canon token alias.
Don't read shadcn's accent as the brand color: bg-accent is the hover wash; the lime is primary / ring.
Don't use Fused Lime for decoration, prose, large fills, or more than the sanctioned signals — a default (lime) Badge or link Button is a primary action, not a label.
Don't use raw #E5FF44 as text or border in the light theme — the light --accent is the contrast-corrected olive-lime.
Don't add shadows to resting surfaces; hairline + ground step carry structure. Floating shadcn surfaces get the ink ring + tokenized shadow, nothing more.
Don't invent new grays — layer rgba(var(--tint), …) washes over existing grounds instead.
Don't give tabs or toggle groups the lime; they mark a place with ground and ink, and the lime stays for "you are here" and "do this".
